run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the maximum average path value through an N by N cost matrix
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a one-dimensional DP array instead of a two-dimensional matrix
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming logic for computing maximum path sum in a grid
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the path with maximum average value from top-left to bottom-right
